packages.title: Cellular Cleanse
packages.description: A practitioner-guided foundational cellular-support pathway for those who want to begin with a structured cleanse and foundational approach. Your starting assessment establishes the foundation for review; when this pathway is appropriate, the practitioner determines the appropriate next step and coordinates the relevant protocol and resources.

A defined next step when the pathway is appropriate
Connection to relevant downstream resources when indicated

gateway.name: Core Access
gateway.headline: Tell us what you're looking for. We'll take it from there.

questions.text: Do you already know what you're looking for?
answers: No — I want help finding the right place to begin

questions.text: What would you most like support with right now?
Which is closest to what you need right now?
Which is closest to what you need right now?
Are you looking for direct CellCore access, or a practitioner-guided starting pathway?
answers: I want the practitioner-guided Cellular Cleanse starting pathway

dm.universal_opening: Absolutely. I can help you find the right place to begin. You don't need to know which program you need. I just need to narrow down what you're looking for.
dm.known_cellcore: Absolutely. If you already know you want CellCore or JumpStart, I'll take you directly to the established CellCore route rather than sending you through a general wellness intake.
dm.known_peptide: Absolutely. If you're specifically looking for peptides, I'll take you directly to the appropriate peptide route.
dm.result: Based on what you've shared, this is the best place to begin. You don't need to figure out the rest of the pathway today. We'll guide you from here.
dm.fallback: I want to make sure we put you in the right place rather than guess. I'll route this for concierge review so we can determine the appropriate starting point.

zapier_jobs: direct CellCore intent -> established CellCore access route
direct peptide intent -> approved peptide route
program route -> Whole Practice client/package activation

fullscript.rule: Map only live, verified practitioner catalog/Journey/product destinations from the connected Fullscript account. Never invent a Journey name, product collection, URL, or bundle.
